'''Bargos's mining operation''' was an [[oridium]] [[Mine/Legends|mine]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gavos]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] owned by [[Bargos (Hutt)|Bargos]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]. A group of adventurers discovered that Bargos' new mines do not produce as much oridium as expected and that [[EV-8D3]], an [[EV-series supervisor droid/Legends|EV-series supervisor droid]], planned to spread a violent [[Gavos Droid Revolution|rebellion]] against [[Species/Legends|organic]] life forms throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].
